title: Volcano of Dreams
description: A surreal black volcano erupts from the bottom center, spewing vibrant, swirling psychedelic smoke in spirals of blue, purple, pink, green and yellow that fill the upper portion of the image. The base and foreground are covered in a dense field of overlapping colorful circles and orbs containing intricate patterns, while faint ghostly figures and golden orbs float within the dark, smoky atmosphere.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a solid black volcano erupting at night, exploding with massive colorful swirling smoke plumes in spirals of blue purple pink green and yellow against a dark smoky sky, foreground completely covered in hundreds of overlapping vibrant circles and patterned orbs in neon colors, ghostly figures and golden glowing orbs floating in the smoke, intricate linework, high contrast, dreamlike atmosphere
